author: Kai Lentit
description:
The Demoscene.

featuring chaos from farbrausch - the creators of Debris, the popular demo, the product etc.

Some people compete in football. Others compete to fit an entire music video into 4 kilobytes. I go to German demoparty to meet the programmers who treat computer graphics like an Olympic sport.

Welcome to the demoscene, an underground world of programmers, hackers, digital artists, and musicians competing to push computers to their absolute limits.

In this comedy documentary, our reporter visits Evoke 2026 Germany, to interview some of the world's most competitive nerds as if they were elite athletes preparing for the Olympics.
